commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Those who fear the fault of disgrace won’t start work they haven’t examined and settled, with their group and alone. Once begun, it can’t be dropped halfway. Disgrace is the scorn the world adds when the work fails, saying they have neither sense nor honour. That scorn is certain, so begin only where you are clear.
